records.command: img=$(docker inspect metrix-platform-authelia-1 --format '{{.Config.Image}}'); docker run --rm --volumes-from metrix-platform-authelia-1 -v /tmp/opencut-legitate-oidc-review.yml:/tmp/review.yml:ro -e X_AUTHELIA_CONFIG_FILTERS=template -e AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_VALIDATION_RESET_PASSWORD_JWT_SECRET_FILE=/run/secrets/authelia_jwt_secret -e AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE=/run/secrets/authelia_session_secret -e AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE=/run/secrets/authelia_storage_encryption_key --entrypoint /app/authelia "$img" config validate --config /tmp/review.yml
